summary.methodology: Sequential Node fetch calls from this machine, one in flight, shared process/connection pool, four warmup calls excluded. Timer starts before fetch and ends after reading the full response body. No retries. Paired synthetic snapshots with small deterministic perturbations; alternating variant order. Accuracy only measures a 300 ms, immediate-action, open-loop collision check; it does NOT measure network-delayed live gameplay. Forecast variant is explicitly assisted by local physics calculations.
